title: ByteDance releases Seedream 5.5 with 100-round editing and transparent assets
summary: ByteDance released Seedream 5.5, an image creation model that supports up to 100 rounds of continuous editing on the same work and can natively generate assets with an alpha \(transparent\) channel. The company says the model also improves image realism and text rendering, and that in its evaluations usability in film/TV and office scenarios reached more than twice that of the previous version. Seedream 5.5 is rolling out progressively on ByteDance&\#x27;s Jimeng, Doubao, Doubao Workspace, and Volcano Ark \(Volcengine\) platforms; the performance figures are vendor claims without published benchmarks in the announcement.
